stories.title: Air India to shift long-haul flights to Mumbai
stories.summary: Air India will move some long-haul operations from Delhi to Mumbai and order more wide-body aircraft to regain market share. CEO Tewolde Gebremariam cited Pakistan's airspace closure as a primary disruption to European and US routes. The airline reported losses exceeding £1.7 billion for 2025-26.

stories.title: Bengaluru airport capacity to rise with mixed-mode runways
stories.summary: The Directorate General of Civil Aviation has approved mixed-mode runway operations for Bengaluru airport. The move is expected to increase aircraft-handling capacity by 42 percent. Officials state the new system will reduce fuel consumption and emissions. The airport follows Delhi in adopting the operational change.

stories.title: Delhi High Court dismisses Air India tax appeal
stories.summary: The Delhi High Court dismissed a CGST Department appeal regarding the taxability of computer reservation system services provided to Air India. The court ruled the matter falls under the appellate jurisdiction of the Supreme Court. The dispute concerns the interpretation of the Central Excise Act of 1944.

The airline cited geopolitical instability and fuel price hikes as primary operational challenges. The plan involves consolidating its network and workforce to fund investments in its fleet, customer experience, and staff.

stories.title: Emirates profit falls as regional conflict persists
stories.summary: Emirates reported a 66 percent year-on-year decline in half-year profit to 903 million dollars, citing regional disruption and high fuel costs. Revenue for the six months ending in September fell 13 percent to 56.9 billion dirhams. The airline says its business model stood up to the test.

stories.title: Turkish Airlines scales back growth targets
stories.summary: Turkish Airlines is shifting capacity toward Asia and Europe while reducing service in the Middle East and Americas. The carrier lowered its full-year growth target to 4 percent from 10 percent. Chairman Murat Seker described the move as a more disciplined approach to growth.

stories.title: DOT to audit FAA oversight of helicopter tours
stories.summary: The Department of Transportation is launching an audit of FAA safety oversight for commercial helicopter tours. The agency cited concerns regarding the industry safety record and regulatory gaps. The announcement follows at least 58 helicopter crashes involving tourists since 2008, including 11 fatal accidents.

stories.title: Air India seeks more widebody jets
stories.summary: Air India is considering additional widebody aircraft orders from Boeing and Airbus to expand its international operations. CEO Tewolde Gebremariam said the airline expects to become profitable very soon. The potential orders would add to existing commitments for 600 aircraft.

stories.title: Avolon finalizes order for 140 Boeing 737-10 jets
stories.summary: Aviation finance firm Avolon finalized an order for 140 Boeing 737-10 aircraft, increasing its backlog to more than 240 units. The FAA certified the 737-10 in October, allowing deliveries to begin. Lessors have ordered over 230 of the jets this year, a fivefold increase from 2025.

stories.summary: Gulfstream delivered 40 business jets in the third quarter, up from 39 a year earlier. Parent company General Dynamics reported a 19.3 percent increase in aerospace operating earnings to 513 million dollars. Aerospace orders reached nearly 5 billion dollars during the quarter.

stories.title: FAA orders inspections for Boeing 787 and 747 fuel tanks
stories.summary: The FAA has ordered inspections on 60 US-registered Boeing 787s and 31 Boeing 747s. The regulator identified conditions that could allow an ignition source to develop inside fuel tanks during lightning strikes. Airlines must now carry out inspections and repairs to mitigate the risk of explosion.

stories.title: OIG to audit FAA oversight of helicopter tour industry
stories.summary: The U.S. Transportation Office of Inspector General is auditing the FAA's oversight of helicopter tours. The probe examines a regulatory loophole that allows some commercial flights to operate under private pilot standards rather than stricter commercial rules. There have been 58 helicopter crashes since 2008.

stories.title: Government gains power to intervene in airfare pricing
stories.summary: The Indian government has notified new rules under the Bharatiya Vayuyan Niyam 2026, allowing it to intervene in airline ticket pricing during extraordinary situations. The ministry stated the move is in the public interest, citing concerns over rising airfares driven by elevated aviation turbine fuel prices.

Cadets will work toward European Union Aviation Safety Agency qualifications before completing license conversions for India. The partnership also aims to increase gender diversity within the aviation industry.

stories.summary: 5X5 Aviation Insurance has partnered with Aviation Performance Solutions to offer policyholders a 5 percent premium credit. The incentive applies to pilots who complete an advanced Upset Prevention and Recovery Training course. The program aims to encourage instruction in preventing in-flight loss-of-control situations.

stories.summary: The National Business Aviation Association is highlighting programs designed to guide students toward careers in business aviation. The organization provides resources for those looking to enter the industry through specialized training and educational pathways. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: Checklist for business aviation scholarships
stories.summary: The National Business Aviation Association has released a guide for students seeking financial support for aviation studies. The checklist outlines the steps required to secure scholarships within the business aviation sector. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: IndiGo adopts virtual reality for emergency training
stories.summary: IndiGo has signed an agreement with Airbus to deploy the A320 Virtual Procedure Trainer. The airline is the first to adopt the platform's abnormal and emergency procedure package. The software uses virtual reality to bridge the gap between ground school and full flight simulators.

stories.title: IndiGo adds virtual cockpit to pilot training
stories.summary: IndiGo has adopted the Airbus Skywise A320 Virtual Procedure Trainer to help pilots practice emergency responses. The airline is the first globally to use the package for technical malfunctions. The system allows for repeated practice in a virtual cockpit as India prepares for larger fleets.

stories.title: India approves 11 new flying training organisations
stories.summary: The central government has approved 11 new flying training organisations to increase the country's pilot training capacity. The move aims to address the rising demand for flight crews as the domestic aviation sector expands. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: American Airlines resumes flights to Haiti
stories.summary: American Airlines has resumed daily service between Miami and Cap-Haïtien, marking the first major US carrier to return since November 2024. The route was suspended following security concerns involving commercial aircraft. The airline last served the destination more than six years ago.
